title: 17 · Generic is not Object
objective: Use type T consistently in the field, constructor and getter.
instructions: Solution<T> holds one T value, without casting to Object in the API.
The constructor takes a T; get() returns T; set(T) updates the value.
hints: If <T> is declared on the class, methods and fields can use T.
Do not declare a new <T> on each method if you want the class's T.
